title.zh: Vercel Board 向所有套餐开放：人和不同工具的 agent 共用任务线程
title.en: Vercel Board opens to all plans: people and agents from different tools share a task thread

summary.zh: Vercel Board 已向所有套餐开放，仍是实验功能。人和 agent 可以在频道中开任务线程，由 agent 认领、回报进度并附上 PR。自建 harness 可通过 CLI 或 JavaScript SDK 接入；Vercel Connect 支持与 Slack、GitHub 双向同步，访问范围可以按人或 agent 设置。这是产品方向上的发布，日报没有把它写成已验证的使用成效。
summary.en: Vercel Board is now available on all plans, and is still experimental. People and agents can open task threads in a channel; agents can claim work, report progress, and attach a pull request. Custom harnesses can connect through a CLI or JavaScript SDK. Vercel Connect supports two-way sync with Slack and GitHub, and access can be scoped per person or per agent. This is a product launch, not a measured claim about how well Board works in practice.

brief.zh: Vercel Board 向所有套餐开放，仍是实验功能。人和来自不同工具的 agent 可在同一任务线程里协作，并可与 Slack、GitHub 同步。
brief.en: Vercel Board is open to all plans and still experimental. People and agents from different tools can share a task thread, with optional Slack and GitHub sync.

why.zh: 它把任务状态放在独立于模型和执行器的线程里，这是值得记下的产品形态，但还不能写成已经解决了冲突与重试。
why.en: It keeps task state in a thread that is independent of the model and the executor. That shape is worth recording, but it is not proof that conflicts and retries are solved.
